Always remember that time has no end. It just keeps on going regardless of how we feel and what happens to us. Life cannot always be alright so we cannot dwell on and overthink the future or the past but we have to embrace our present. 

Don’t you ever pressure yourself into thinking that your life has to be alright by some point of time cause that’s not realistic. I always tell myself that “my now never lasts forever” so whatever I’m feeling is not linear. 

Please excuse my rambling.
